descriptions.value: This early framework applies to the Merina polity. The generic Madagascar label in 1800 does not establish sole Merina sovereignty across the island. Contradictory named reign dates are omitted.

descriptions.value: The 1752 separation from Portuguese India established the Mozambique, Sofala and Rios de Sena administration. African polities persisted. Modern boundaries do not prove complete Portuguese rule; Delagoa Bay is not automatically equivalent to the whole administration.
Late nineteenth-century Portuguese claims and company concessions coexisted with local resistance. The ministry account of 1929 occupation is not proof of uniform control everywhere.
Domestic overseas-province designation dates from 1951. Colonial rule continued in 1960. Later liberation warfare,1972 autonomy and 1975 independence are not projected backward.

politicalStatus.value: British colony

descriptions.value: The 26 July 1878 debate attests colonial representative institutions on this day. Racial exclusion and colonial coercion prevent equating this system with inclusive democracy.
The 31 August 1880 debate discusses Natal colonial institutions on this day. Later responsible government is not projected backward.
The 12 December 1900 debate attests Natal as an existing colony. Most Zululand had been annexed to Natal in 1897, but the historical Zulu area is not identical to Natal territory.

limitations: Broad partial institutional frameworks; statistics, flags and exhaustive officeholders deliberately omitted.
No repository/Git writes by worker. Parent alone integrates and runs production/browser/regression checks.
Two raw identities remain mapping-review; narrower gaps also recorded individually.
Natal1878 representative legislature is not styled the later1893 LegislativeAssembly; Mozambique1878 government does not assume later concessionary-company institutions.
Merina, Portuguese Mozambique, Natal and French Madagascar shared administrations each use one entity with separately sourced periods; no duplicate temporal entities for the same administration.
Current production registry checked twice for matching administrations; none present during build. Parent must recheck after earlier batches integrate.
historicalCautions: Madagascar1800 island geography is not sole Merina sovereignty. Merina named reign contradictions are omitted.
Madagascar1960 changes from autonomous French Community republic to independent republic on26June.25June recognition/message dating does not change independence.
French Madagascar prewar and1945 coverage is disjoint; WWII occupation and1946 changes are not frozen backward.
Transvaal1878 is British-annexed, not an independent Boer republic.1880 council and1900 military profiles cover actual source-attested days.
Boer resistance persisted after1900 British annexation claims; proposed civil institutions are not implemented facts.
Zulu kingdom1878 and postwar partition1880 differ; most Zululand enteringNatal does not prove the entire1900 raw is one administration.
Swaziland1960 remained under British proclamation government. Later legislature, protected-state constitution and independence are not backdated.
Portuguese Mozambique province terminology from1951 remains colonial dependency; claims and effective control differ.
Rozvi political state is distinct from modern people identity; no precise oral-tradition lifetime is invented.
Walbis1938 source attribute conflicts with South African administrative history; fail closed pending identity classification review.
